streams.note: every random stream runs over the pair dimension list (entry dims, exit dims, a.N, b.C, c.X, c.Y); a cell uses its active dimensions only
streams.global: Sobol, seed sha256("study3c|<history>|<entry>|<exit>|<contract>|global"), points 0-255 first pass, 256-2047 deep
streams.local: Sobol, seed sha256("study3c|<history>|<entry>|<exit>|<contract>|local|<k>"), k = 0..3 (the k-th seed of distinctBest(2, 2))
streams.joint: mulberry32(seed sha256("study3c|<history>|<entry>|<exit>|<contract>|joint|<centerIndex>")): per draw one uniform per pair dimension in order; J17 = draws 0-15, J33 = draws 0-31
streams.fixedParent: Sobol over the four rule slots, seed sha256("study3c|<history>|<entry>|<exit>|<contract>|FP|global"); joint draws "…|FP|joint|<centerIndex>"
streams.nulls: mulberry32(seed sha256("study3c|null|<kind>|<j>")): one uniform per fold in order A, B, C, D, index = floor(u * pool size)
streams.J128: mulberry32(seed sha256("study3c|<policyId>|J128")): per draw one uniform per searched dimension in order
